# The Agent Engineer — Balaji Chippada

> Free 26-week Agentic AI Engineer roadmap (170K+ YouTube views) and live demo-first masterclasses. Production RAG, LangGraph, MCP, multi-agent systems, guardrails, AWS deployment — not tutorial fluff.

Balaji Chippada teaches software engineers to ship production-grade agentic AI systems. This website combines an interactive roadmap with embedded video lessons, progress tracking, and live cohort masterclasses.

- [Home](https://balajichippada.com/): Overview, live masterclass schedule, how it works, curriculum preview, instructor bio
- [Roadmap](https://balajichippada.com/roadmap): Interactive 9-phase / 26-week curriculum with module videos, playlists, and login-gated progress tracking
- [Masterclasses](https://balajichippada.com/masterclasses): Live, demo-first build sessions (RAG, Claude Code, LangGraph, deployment) — free and paid
- [About](https://balajichippada.com/about): Balaji Chippada — instructor background and credentials

## Guides & reference

- [How to Become an Agentic AI Engineer in 2026](https://balajichippada.com/guides/how-to-become-an-agentic-ai-engineer): Step-by-step guide — skills, the 9-phase path, projects, and how to start
- [Agentic AI Glossary](https://balajichippada.com/glossary): Plain-English definitions of 28 core terms (RAG, MCP, LangGraph, ReAct, guardrails, LLMOps, etc.)

## What this site offers

- **Free roadmap**: 9 phases, 60+ modules, 3 capstone projects — Python → LLM fundamentals → Prompt engineering → RAG & eval → Tools/MCP → Memory → Multi-agent → Guardrails/LLMOps → Cloud deployment
- **Live masterclasses**: Demo-first builds (Claude Code, RAG, LangGraph). Book via the site; free and paid sessions available
- **Community**: WhatsApp group for reminders and discussion

## Curriculum phases (summary)

1. Python Foundations (weeks 1–3) — Core Python, OOP, HTTP APIs, FastAPI, async
2. LLM Mental Model (week 4) — Tokenization, context windows, reasoning models, benchmarks
3. Prompt Engineering (weeks 5–7) — API access, CoT, prompt caching, DSPy
4. RAG + Evaluation (weeks 8–12) — Embeddings, chunking, vector DBs, Ragas eval
5. Tools, MCP & Single Agents (weeks 13–16) — Function calling, ReAct, LangChain agents
6. Memory & Context (weeks 17–19) — Episodic memory, semantic cache, compression
7. Multi-Agent Orchestration (weeks 20–22) — LangGraph, supervisor patterns, A2A
8. Guardrails & LLMOps (weeks 23–24) — Input/output/action guardrails, observability
9. Cloud Deployment (weeks 25–26) — AWS ECS, API Gateway, cost control

## Capstone projects

- Distributed document ingestion + RAG pipeline (Phase 4)
- Multi-agent orchestration system (Phase 7)
- Production agent deployment on AWS (Phase 9)
